page: Microsoft Azure E48as_v4 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the EASv4 family. It is powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 7763 processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The instance features 48 virtual CPUs mapped to 24 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, operating at a clock speed of 3.525 GHz. It is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. Local storage includes 786 GB of capacity, and the instance is Premium Storage capable.

Benchmark evaluations indicate strong multi-core performance, with stress-ng multi-core CPU and PassMark CPU tests scoring in the top 25%. Memory subsystem performance is highly competitive, as evidenced by a PassMark memory score in the top 10%, although uncached large-block memory read and write bandwidths remain in the average tier. Cryptographic capabilities are robust, supported by hardware-accelerated AES and VAES instructions, resulting in a strong PassMark CPU encryption score.

While the instance excels in multi-threaded decompression and image processing, certain workloads show limitations. Large-scale LLM text generation using a 70B model falls into the bottom 25% of performance, reflecting the lack of dedicated GPU acceleration. Database operations and Redis SET throughput perform within the average range. This hardware profile is best suited for memory-intensive enterprise applications, large-scale data processing, caching layers, and medium-sized relational database workloads.
